svg.title: Loop order and memory access
svg.desc: Comparison of ijk and ikj loop orders: ijk reads matrix B down a column, touching a new cache line each time; ikj reads along a row, reusing one cache line.
svg.text: Loop order matters: same math, very different memory traffic
Row-major storage. In this toy example one cache line holds one row of B (8 elements).
Inner loop walks down a column of B (stride N)
for i: for j: for k:
C[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j] // B: stride N
Inner loop walks along a row of B (stride 1)
for i: for k: for j:
